sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: 5 Apple Stories: Peter Thiel, iPhone Duo, Nvidia and MacBook Buzz - Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL)
feed.summary: This article covers five key stories surrounding Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL), highlighting investor Peter Thiel's critique of Apple's innovation post-Steve Jobs, and Gene Munster's optimistic projections for the iPhone Duo. It also discusses Apple's nearing market capitalization of Nvidia, speculation around a touchscreen MacBook Pro, and Bank of America's continued 'Buy' rating for Apple due to strong iPhone Duo demand.

feed.title: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. $SWKS Position Lessened by Robeco Institutional Asset Management B.V.
feed.summary: Robeco Institutional Asset Management B.V. reduced its stake in Skyworks Solutions, Inc. by 14.2% in the third quarter of 2026, selling 15,965 shares but still holding 96,729 shares valued at $8.27 million. Despite mixed analyst sentiment (five Buy, seventeen Hold, two Sell ratings, with a consensus "Hold" and $80.53 target price), Skyworks exceeded earnings and revenue estimates for the quarter. The company reported $1.08 EPS and $934.8 million in revenue, though revenue saw a 3.1% year-over-year decline.
